rule: Weekly bullish engulfing, bought on a daily close above the previous day's high, only while BTC is above its 50-day average

cases.setup: Weekly bullish engulfing, confirmed on the daily chart, with BTC in an uptrend

checks.text: The week of 2020-07-13 closed lower: open 9,303.31, close 9,208.99.
The week of 2020-07-20 engulfed it: it opened at 9,208.99 (at or below 9,208.99) and closed at 9,931.54 (at or above 9,303.31), with a bigger body.
The trigger: on 2020-07-26 the daily candle closed green at 9,931.54, above the previous day's high 9,732.90.
The BTC filter: bitcoin closed that day at 9,931.54, above its 50-day average 9,357.50.
Stop 2 ATR below the entry: the 14-day ATR is 224.78, so the stop is 9,483.96. Sell after 28 days unless the stop is hit first.

cases.how: On Binance, open BTC/USDT and switch to the 1W chart (weeks start Monday 00:00 UTC). Find the weeks of 2020-07-13 and 2020-07-20. Then switch to 1D and find 2020-07-26: it closes above the high of 2020-07-25. For the filter, open BTC/USDT on 1D with a 50-day simple moving average.
